name: Geomacro Agent
description: 24/7 geopolitical, macroeconomic and critical-mineral risk intelligence for AI agents. GeoMacro provides authenticated A2A task coordination plus availability-first x402 delivery, and never authorizes execution.

apiKeySecurityScheme.name: X-Geomacro-Api-Secret
apiKeySecurityScheme.description: Geomacro Testnet developer API secret. Required together with the Testnet API key.

skills.name: Risk preflight
skills.description: Evaluate a country or directional corridor before an agent payment or exposure action. Returns Risk Gate decision context, a verified signed Risk Object, structural context and canonical GRI context. Geomacro never authorizes execution.
examples: Assess India before a treasury payment.
Evaluate the India to Singapore corridor before an agent payment.

skills.name: Global geopolitical risk intelligence
skills.description: Authenticated country and corridor geopolitical/security context, including governed conflict, sanctions/restrictions, governance, trade disruption and hot-topic evidence when current coverage is deliverable.
examples: Assess current geopolitical risk for a supported country.

skills.name: Global macro and FX risk intelligence
skills.description: Authenticated macro, monetary, sovereign/fiscal, banking and FX/external-vulnerability context with freshness, provenance and commercial-eligibility gates.
examples: Assess macro and FX vulnerability for a supported country.

skills.name: Global critical-minerals risk intelligence
skills.description: Authenticated critical-mineral supply, concentration, policy, disruption and cross-border risk context where governed source coverage is current and commercially eligible.
examples: Assess critical-mineral supply risk affecting a supported country or corridor.
